# The Business of Pharmacy Podcast

> > A weekly podcast exploring pharmacy industry trends, business strategy, and innovation through conversations with industry leaders, entrepreneurs, and advocates.

The Business of Pharmacy Podcast, hosted by Mike Koelzer, features in-depth interviews with pharmacy professionals, business executives, and industry experts. The show covers critical topics including PBM reform, pharmacy profitability, financial planning, and workforce innovation.

## Key Topics

- PBM Reform
- Pharmacy Business
- Financial Planning
- Pharmacy Advocacy
- Independent Pharmacy
- Pharmacy Ownership
- CEO Interviews
- Pharmaceutical Negotiation
- Workforce Scheduling
- Specialty Medications
- Healthcare Technology
- Pharmacy Profitability
- Pharmacy Law & Regulations
- Pharmacist Leadership

- [The Business of Pharmacy Podcast](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com): Homepage for The Business of Pharmacy Podcast with weekly episodes on pharmacy industry trends.
- [Listen to Past Episodes](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/episodes): Archive of past podcast episodes featuring guests like Tim Ulbrich and Benjamin Jolley.
- [About The Podcast](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/about): About page detailing The Business of Pharmacy Podcast mission and founder Mike Koelzer.
- [Former Guests](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/guests): Directory of podcast guests from Aaron Hannah to Acacia Flory and beyond.

## PBM Reform & Pharmacy Advocacy

- [The Power of Speaking to 20,000 People About PBMs](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/the-power-of-speaking-to-20000-people-about-pbms-benjamin-jolley-pharmd-apex-pharmacy-consultin): Episode with Benjamin Jolley on PBM reform advocacy and pharmaceutical negotiation.
- [Michael Hogue, APha, American Pharmacists Association](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/michael-hogue-apha): Episode with APhA CEO Michael Hogue on pharmacy advocacy and industry transformation.
- [Greg Reybold](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/guests/greg-reybold): Guest profile of Greg Reybold on PBM reform and pharmacy advocacy.

## Business Strategy & Financial Planning

- [Why Six Figures Isn't a Financial Plan](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/why-six-figures-isnt-a-financial-plan-tim-ulbrich-pharmd-your-financial-pharmacist-co-founder): Episode with Tim Ulbrich on pharmacist financial planning and managing six-figure income.
- [Making Pharmacy Profitable](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/making-pharmacy-profitable-lisa-faast-pharmd-diversifyrx): Episode with DiversifyRx CEO Lisa Faast on pharmacy profitability and business strategy.
- [Great Negotiation Means Everyone Wins](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/great-negotiation-means-everyone-wins-arun-swaminathan-mm-phd-pharm-sci-coya-theraeutics-ceo): Episode with Coya Therapeutics CEO on pharmaceutical partnerships and negotiation strategy.
- [Koelzer Brothers Reminisce: Lessons from the Pharmacy & Dad](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/koelzer-brothers-reminisce-lessons-from-the-pharmacy-dad-pete-tom-tim-mike-koelzer-koelzer): Episode featuring Koelzer brothers reflecting on family pharmacy lessons and values.

## Pharmacy Innovation & Technology

- [Erick Von Schweber](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/guests/erick-von-schweber): Guest profile of Erick Von Schweber on AI and medication management.

## Pharmacy Operations & Workforce

- [Scheduling The Modern Workforce](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/scheduling-the-modern-workforce-ceo-chad-halvorson-of-when-i-work): Episode with When I Work CEO on workforce scheduling and employee management.
- [Pharmacist Moms](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/pharmacist-moms-founder-suzy-soliman-pharmd): Episode with Pharmacist Moms founder Suzy Soliman on women in pharmacy.
- [Navigating Pharmacy Law and Regulations](https://www.bizofpharmpod.com/navigating-pharmacy-law-and-regulations-lucas-morgan-atty-frier-levitt): Episode with attorney Lucas Morgan on pharmacy law and regulatory compliance.
